name: boothcheck API
description: Read-only derived data from SEC filings: what a stock price is betting on (implied growth, duration, margin), research report sections, segment snapshots, peer cohorts, a management guidance track record, risk-factor additions, insider and holder fact registers, and the cross-company analyst desk (one table and deterministic brief across 2 to 25 names, available to signed-in Founding Access accounts). No Boothcheck house fair value, price target, or rating. Informational and research purposes only.
